data.name: Stretch_OverheadReach_Area
data.comment: Body area, shown under the exercise

data.name: Stretch_OverheadReach_Instruction
data.value: Interlace your fingers and reach up high, breathing slowly. Lower your arms and let your shoulders settle.

data.name: Stretch_SideBend_Instruction
data.value: Reach one arm overhead and lean gently to the opposite side. Switch sides halfway through.

data.name: Stretch_ShoulderShrug_Instruction
data.value: Lift both shoulders toward your ears, hold a moment, then let them drop. Repeat a few times.

data.name: Stretch_NeckRoll_Instruction
data.value: Slowly tilt your head toward one shoulder and roll it gently across to the other. Keep it easy and relaxed.

data.name: Stretch_SeatedTwist_Instruction
data.value: Sit tall and turn your upper body to one side, holding the chair back. Switch sides after a few breaths.

data.name: Stretch_WristStretch_Instruction
data.value: Extend one arm with the palm up and gently draw the fingers back with the other hand. Switch hands.

data.name: Stretch_HipFlexor_Instruction
data.value: Stand and step one foot back, shifting your weight forward until you feel a light stretch at the front of the hip. Switch legs.

data.name: Stretch_CalfRaises_Instruction
data.value: Stand tall and rise onto your toes, then lower slowly. Hold a chair if you like. Repeat several times.
